title: Choose your plan
subtitle: Pick the plan that fits your business. You can change it later from Billing.

size.title: Not sure which plan? Tell us roughly how big you are
size.hint: Optional. We estimate about {{minutes}} minutes per call. This only highlights a plan; every plan stays available.

suggest.editable: You can always choose a different plan below.

reason.fits_all: It covers the numbers you entered at the lowest estimated monthly cost.
reason.minutes_overage: About {{minutes}} minutes a month is more than it includes, so {{overage}} minutes would be billed at its overage rate.
reason.beyond_self_serve: Your numbers are beyond the self-serve plans, so a custom plan from our sales team fits best.
reason.cheaper_as_enterprise: At this volume a custom plan is likely to cost less. Talk to our sales team.

plans.taxNote: Prices are in US dollars and exclude taxes. Any tax that applies is calculated at checkout.

terms.title: Before you pay
terms.pick: Choose a plan to see exactly what will be charged and when.
terms.enterprise: Enterprise plans are set up with our sales team. Nothing is charged from this page.
terms.trialCard: Free for {{days}} days. A card is required. {{price}} per {{period}} is charged when the trial ends unless you cancel before then.
terms.trialNoCard: Free for {{days}} days, no card needed to start. To keep your plan after the trial, add a payment method; the plan then costs {{price}} per {{period}}.
terms.payNow: {{price}} per {{period}} is charged today when you subscribe.
terms.renews: The plan renews automatically every {{period}} until you cancel.
terms.cancel: You can cancel any time from Billing in your account.
terms.tax: Taxes, if any, are shown on the payment page before you confirm.

links.lead: By continuing you agree to our

reminder.label: Email me one reminder if I don't finish (after about {{hours}} hours)
reminder.help: Optional. One email, only about finishing this step.

skip.label: Skip for now
skip.help: You can look around the dashboard. Vireek can't answer your calls until a plan is active.

notices.cancelled: Checkout was cancelled and nothing was charged. Your plan choice is saved.
notices.expired: That payment session expired. Nothing was charged. Please continue again.

errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
errors.promoInvalid: That promo code isn't valid. Check it or clear the field.
errors.annualUnavailable: Annual billing isn't available yet. Please choose monthly.
errors.notEligible: Only the account owner can choose a plan.
errors.notConfigured: Payments aren't fully set up yet. Please contact support.
errors.unavailable: Something went wrong starting checkout. Nothing was charged. Please try again.

confirm.title: Confirming your payment…
confirm.body: This usually takes a few seconds. Please keep this page open.
confirm.slowBody: Your payment is taking longer than usual to confirm. Your plan switches on as soon as it does. You can continue to your dashboard.

loadError.title: We couldn't load your plan options
loadError.body: Check your connection and try again.

plan.title: Finish choosing your plan
plan.body: Your choice is saved. It takes a minute to finish.

checkout.title: Finish checkout
checkout.body: You started checkout but didn't finish. Nothing was charged.

skipped.title: You're on limited access
skipped.body: Vireek can't answer your calls until you pick a plan.
